test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

He said, "I shall need a copy of the documents."

options.text: He said that he will need a copy of the documents.
He said that he shall need a copy of the document.
He said that he is going to need a copy of the document
He said that he would need a copy of the documents

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4)**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** He said that he would need a copy of the documents.
 
• **Direct to Indirect Speech:** 
 
 
• **Pronoun Change:** 
 
 
• "I" is changed to "he" to match the subject of the reporting verb.<
